en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Al Halby, from Abdul Al Hameed Al Tai’y, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[9:105] And say: Work; so Allah will See your work and (so will) His Rasool and the Believers.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They (the Believers) are the Imams<sup>asws</sup>’.
